name: dsh-computer-use-like-codex
description: Independent macOS background computer use for DSH: AX actions, PID/window-targeted input, synthetic activation, focus observations and window screenshots.

permissions.summary: Local macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording through the DSH host. Targeted desktop input and window snapshots; images use DSH attachments and its configured model. No cloud API, clipboard use, global input posting or automatic foreground fallback.
permissions.externalServices: None; screenshot attachments are delivered through the existing DSH model route
permissions.failureBoundaries: Missing permission, stale snapshot, moved/minimized/offscreen window or missing private interface returns a structured error. Input is never automatically retried. If the background target acquires system focus, remaining events stop. Other foreground app changes are recorded.
